components.text: I meet the bar on 3 today. In a year: all 5, and cross-team work a notch higher.

notes: This is how I score myself against the role. Membership is my strongest skill, a notch above what the role needs. Data and cross-team work are right at the bar. Specs and engineering work are one notch short, and roadmapping is two notches short, my widest gap. My one-year goal is to meet the bar on all five, and push cross-team work a notch higher.
